Downloaded: 2026-09-20

Original zip: kenney_pixel-vehicle-pack.zip from
  https://kenney.nl/media/pages/assets/pixel-vehicle-pack/570a4c9051-1677578609/kenney_pixel-vehicle-pack.zip
Original zip sha256: b582163a0f366d8d24821eb763892ac29ff780a011e9b7b42baf86d1f051803f
Tile size: irregular small sprites, mostly under 32x16 px, top-down/slightly
  angled cars, vans, trucks, a bus, bikes and a scooter -- about 45 vehicles.
Covers: parked/decorative cars for parking lots and the campus road (FB-0025
  explicitly asked for "parked cars"). More color/model variety than the cars
  built into the Roguelike Modern City pack above.
Does not cover: driving animation frames (these are static top-down sprites,
  not spritesheets with rotation frames) -- fine for parked cars, not for a
  moving-traffic feature if one is ever added.
